basic_info.headline: Microsoft Software Developer | Grace Hopper Scholar | Chapman University Alum
basic_info.about:
Experienced Research Assistant with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Python, Java, C++ and HTML. Hard working professional with an in progress Bachelor of Science focused in Computer Science as well as minors in Data Analytics and the University Honors Program from Chapman University. Demonstrated leadership potential as a two term Executive Board Member at Chapman University's Pi Beta Phi Sorority, Co-Founder and President at Chapman University’s Data Analytics Association, and Public Relations Manager at Chapman University's Love Your Melon Club.

Summer 2019 Intern for Microsoft in Remond, Washington. 
2018 AnitaB.org Grace Hopper Conference Scholarship Recipient

2020 Outstanding Senior Award Recipient from the Computer Science Major. Graduated Magna Cum Laude with Computer Science Program Honors. 
2020 Outstanding Senior Award Recipient from the University Honors Program.

experience.title: Fowler School of Engineering Peer Advisor
experience.description:
Advised students on
•	4-year plans for their major and/or minor in the College of Engineering
•	Internships and career advising
•	Worked with students to look over and suggested edits to resumes
experience.position: Fowler School of Engineering Peer Advisor

experience.title: Fellow
experience.description:
Rewriting the Code is a 501 (c)(3) dedicated to developing and empowering a community of college women with a passion for technology to become the next generation of exceptional engineers and tech leaders.
• Attend webinars to learn more about current technologies, career development, and important job skills.
• Become part of a year-long fellowship program and community of female college students interested in pursuing computer science and engineering.

experience.title: President
experience.description:
Co-Founder and President of Chapman University's Data Analytics Association. In charge of external events such as preparing speakers and company information sessions, networking, and career development.
Club Focuses:
•	A platform for interesting guest speakers, including professors and professionals in the Data Science field.
•	An environment to learn new skills, programming languages, and software.
•	An opportunity to develop your career path, including resume and application assistance.
•	A place to take part in statistical programming competitions in a unique team setting.
•	A resource for assistance regarding homework and projects from the exec board at the Data Analytics Association.

experience.title: Research Assistant
experience.company: Machine Learning and Assistive Technology Lab
experience.description:
An on campus research lab run by the head of the computer science department
•	Assisted paper relating to  software deep learning  utilizing data on IntelliSense code completion capture information on source code (ICMSR)
•	Wrote paper using still images from a video tutorial  that contain code and taught a computer to classify the language of the code (ICPC)
•	Compiled data using data mining programs utilizing java
•	Published paper & poster dealing with topic modeling of the R programing language and its common uses (ISCE)
•	Working on paper relating topic modeling from children’s essays to mental health data as adults
experience.companyName: Machine Learning and Assistive Technology Lab
